goal: Organization members can browse real organization repositories and administrators can manage existing organization Secrets, Registries, and Agents through a responsive prototype-aligned settings hierarchy with active lifecycle ownership.
non_goals: Do not add organization members, invitations, teams, metrics, audit data, Secret value reveal, Registry verification/testing, Agent binding, Agent online/busy/resource telemetry, prototype fixtures, new APIs/types/stores/backend behavior/dependencies, or permission calculations.
Do not change Registry address URL behavior without a focused red regression, explicit API-client scope expansion, refreshed CodeGraph, and another entry pass.
Do not implement administration, personal settings, authentication, not-found, operations, or baseline task 5.5 family-wide parity closure.
expected_evidence: Focused router and component tests covering the four organization destinations, settings redirect, admin/member and Agent feature gates, explicit loading/empty/no-match/error/retry states, CRUD and pagination, and 390px containment.
A -> B -> A deferred-response regressions proving organization, permission, list, save, and delete completions belong to the active organization lifecycle.
Supporting repository settings and AgentManager regressions proving shared component extraction preserves current consumers.
Full frontend Vitest, targeted Prettier, ESLint, TypeScript, Vite build, JSON/JSONL, SpecNav entry, diff checks, and task-local desktop/mobile browser evidence.
Evidence-bearing task report and independent spec/quality reviews that keep baseline task 5.5 and full A2 verification open.
unsafe_assumptions: Existing backend permission tests do not prove frontend route, hierarchy, state, or async ownership behavior.
Frontend OrgPermissions visibility does not replace server MustOrgMember enforcement.
Agent registration is not binding and last_contact does not prove a live status.
Prototype-only statistics, members, teams, verification states, usage counts, audit data, resource telemetry, and fixed controls are not production data contracts.
stop_condition: Stop if implementation needs files outside the locked task scope, a new route/API/type/store/backend/dependency/authentication/permission/migration contract, prototype-only data, Registry URL behavior without a red-proven scope expansion, duplicated shared Settings presentation, or task 5.5 family-wide parity closure.
